notes:
Summary: Inkwell builds an IDE copilot aimed at small-to-mid OSS and internal dev teams. Want repository-aware completions: embeddings over repo + heuristics for chunking + fast vector DB lookups. Key ask: sub-100ms cold-start completion times and streaming token latency <=20ms per chunk.

Customer quotes: "We need completions that understand cross-repo references and package-level context, not just single-file prompts."

Technical priorities:
- Repo indexing cadence: incremental per-commit or nightly diffing.
- Embedding strategy: chunk size experiments (256-1024 tokens), semantic + structural metadata, hybrid lexical filters.
- Vector DB: prefer managed but must support point-in-time backups and EU residency for tenant data.
- Model pinning: pin a stable code-optimized model for prod; allow canary variant for new releases.
- Streaming: low-latency streaming to IDE (WebSocket) with partial token delivery and backpressure handling.

Security/compliance notes:
- Must integrate with SSO (Okta), enforce SCIM provisioning.
- Audit logs for inference (request id, model version, tokens used) retained 1 year.
- KMS for key wrapping, customer wants option to bring-key in Dedicated.

Business/Procurement:
- POC scope: 6-week technical evaluation (indexing + 2 repos, 1M embeddings, latency SLAs).
- Pricing sensitivity: strict unit-cost target for embeddings and streaming tokens.
- Procurement timeline: legal + security review in parallel; target procurement May 2026.

Notes from recent calls:
- 2026-02-14: Intro call (Fireflies ff_20260214_inkwell_intro) - product + infra overview.
- 2026-02-28: Deep dive on repo architecture w/ SE (Arjun) - discussed chunking heuristics and vector DB ops.
- 2026-03-05: Security follow-up - provided SOC2 docs and draft SLA.

POC success criteria (customer-stated):
1) Median completion latency <=100ms for 90th percentile dev flows.
2) Embedding recall @k=10 >= 86% on curated test prompts.
3) Deterministic model pinning + rollout safety (canary + auto-rollback).
